jonathan kuminga.name: Jonathan Kuminga
jonathan kuminga.comment: The Hawks announced Wednesday that Kuminga (knee) will be re-evaluated in about one week.

jayson tatum.name: Jayson Tatum
jayson tatum.comment: Tatum (Achilles) said that he was "feeling good" after taking part in practice with the G League's Maine Celtics on Tuesday, but he remained non-committal about returning to action during the 2025-26 season, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports. "[It's been] 39 weeks [since Achilles surgery], so it's been a long journey," Tatum said. "[Practicing] was the next step. Doesn't mean that I'm coming back [this season] or I'm not. It's just following the plan."

ziaire williams.name: Ziaire Williams
ziaire williams.comment: Williams (personal) is out for Friday's game against the Thunder.

nic claxton.name: Nic Claxton

grant williams.name: Grant Williams

liam mcneeley.name: Liam McNeeley

coby white.name: Coby White

jaden ivey.name: Jaden Ivey

guerschon yabusele.name: Guerschon Yabusele
guerschon yabusele.comment: Yabusele is listed as probable for Saturday's game against the Pistons due to a left calf contusion.

noa essengue.name: Noa Essengue

evan mobley.name: Evan Mobley
evan mobley.comment: Mobley will be rested Friday against Charlotte.

max strus.name: Max Strus

max christie.name: Max Christie
max christie.comment: Christie (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Timberwolves.

cooper flagg.name: Cooper Flagg

kyrie irving.name: Kyrie Irving

dereck lively ii.name: Dereck Lively II
dereck lively ii.comment: Lively successfully underwent surgery on his right foot Sunday.

peyton watson.name: Peyton Watson
peyton watson.comment: Watson is expected to miss at least four weeks with his Grade 2 right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

aaron gordon.name: Aaron Gordon
aaron gordon.comment: Gordon (hamstring) will be re-evaluated in 4-to-6 weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reported Thursday.

tamar bates.name: Tamar Bates

tolu smith.name: Tolu Smith
tolu smith.comment: Smith is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Bulls due to a right knee contusion.

isaiah stewart.name: Isaiah Stewart
isaiah stewart.comment: Stewart will be suspended for seven games for his involvement in an altercation with Charlotte's Miles Bridges and Moussa Diabate on Monday, ESPN's Shams Charania reports.

stephen curry.name: Stephen Curry
stephen curry.comment: Curry will have his right knee injury re-evaluated by medical staff in 10 days, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

seth curry.name: Seth Curry
seth curry.comment: Curry (sciatica) will be re-evaluated in about two weeks, Danny Emerman of SFStandard.com reports.

l.j. cryer.name: L.J. Cryer

jimmy butler iii.name: Jimmy Butler III

fred vanvleet.name: Fred VanVleet
fred vanvleet.comment: VanVleet suffered a torn ACL and may be out for the entire 2025-26 campaign, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

aaron nesmith.name: Aaron Nesmith

andrew nembhard.name: Andrew Nembhard

pascal siakam.name: Pascal Siakam

obi toppin.name: Obi Toppin
obi toppin.comment: Head coach Rick Carlisle said that Toppin (foot) was a limited participant in Tuesday's practice and that it's going to be "a while" until he returns to game action, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

ivica zubac.name: Ivica Zubac

johnny furphy.name: Johnny Furphy

tyrese haliburton.name: Tyrese Haliburton
tyrese haliburton.comment: Haliburton said Tuesday in his appearance on the "Mind the Game" podcast that he has resumed taking part in 3-on-3 and 4-on-4 work on the court while he continues to recover from right Achilles surgery.

kawhi leonard.name: Kawhi Leonard
kawhi leonard.comment: Leonard (ankle) will not return to Friday's game against the Lakers, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

john collins.name: John Collins
john collins.comment: Collins (head) won't return to Friday's game against the Lakers, Law Murray of The Athletic reports. He'll finish with 12 points (5-8 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 1-2 FT), one rebound and one steal across 16 minutes.

darius garland.name: Darius Garland
darius garland.comment: Garland (toe) is considered week-to-week, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

bradley beal.name: Bradley Beal

scotty pippen jr..name: Scotty Pippen Jr.

walter clayton jr..name: Walter Clayton Jr.

cedric coward.name: Cedric Coward

santi aldama.name: Santi Aldama

ja morant.name: Ja Morant
ja morant.comment: Morant is continuing to experience discomfort during his recovery from a UCL sprain in his left elbow, and he'll be reevaluated in two weeks, the Grizzlies announced.

zach edey.name: Zach Edey
zach edey.comment: The Grizzlies announced Wednesday that Edey continues to recover from a stress reaction in his left ankle and will maintain his current plan of offloading and rehabilitation before being re-evaluated in six weeks.

brandon clarke.name: Brandon Clarke
brandon clarke.comment: Clarke is progressing well from his Grade 2 right calf strain and is expected to return in four to six weeks, the Grizzlies announced Wednesday.

tyler herro.name: Tyler Herro
tyler herro.comment: Herro (ribs) finished with 24 points (9-14 FG, 2-4 3Pt, 4-4 FT), four rebounds, three assists and one steal across 23 minutes off the bench in Friday's 128-97 win over the Hawks.

terry rozier.name: Terry Rozier
terry rozier.comment: The NBA placed Rozier on immediate leave from the Heat on Thursday, ESPN's Shams Charania reports.

giannis antetokounmpo.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
giannis antetokounmpo.comment: Antetokounmpo (calf) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pelicans.

myles turner.name: Myles Turner
myles turner.comment: Turner (calf) is out for Friday's game against New Orleans.

taurean prince.name: Taurean Prince
taurean prince.comment: The Bucks applied for a Disabled Player Exception for Prince earlier this month, indicating that they anticipate that he's "substantially more likely than not" to be unable to play through June 15, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports.

rudy gobert.name: Rudy Gobert
rudy gobert.comment: Gobert logged 22 points (9-11 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 4-8 FT), 17 rebounds, one assist, three blocks and one steal over 32 minutes during Friday's 122-111 win over the Mavericks.

trey murphy iii.name: Trey Murphy III

yves missi.name: Yves Missi

micah peavy.name: Micah Peavy

ajay mitchell.name: Ajay Mitchell

shai gilgeous-alexander.name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander

jalen williams.name: Jalen Williams

joel embiid.name: Joel Embiid

shaedon sharpe.name: Shaedon Sharpe

d'angelo russell.name: D'Angelo Russell
